attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Vermont state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus based on "doing business" standard.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in VT (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "VT" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets VT economic nexus ("doing business" standard)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "VT" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: add "VT filing required due to physical presence. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5833" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "VT filing required due to physical presence. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5833" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - filing required; VT filing required due to economic nexus ("doing business" standard)
action_details.action_dsl: add "VT filing required due to economic nexus (doing business standard). Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5833" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "VT filing required due to economic nexus (doing business standard). Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5833" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No VT nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No VT nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VT nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate VT state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT state additions and subtractions; Calculate VT-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "VT income adjustments calculated. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5832" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "VT income adjustments calculated. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5832" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No VT nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "No VT nexus - no adjustments calculated." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No VT nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate VT state corporate income tax. Applies VT graduated tax rates (6.0%, 7.0%, 8.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. VT has one of the highest top corporate tax rates in the nation at 8.5%.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT tax using graduated brackets (6%, 7%, 8.5%); VT income tax using graduated rates: 6% up to $10K, 7% $10K-$25K, 8.5% over $25K
action_details.action_dsl: set vt_apportionment.calculated_tax = (the minimum of (apportionment.state_taxable_income) and (vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_1)) * vt_apportionment.tax_rate_tier1; if apportionment.state_taxable_income > vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_1 then set vt_apportionment.calculated_tax = vt_apportionment.calculated_tax + ((the minimum of (apportionment.state_taxable_income) and (vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_2)) - vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_1) * vt_apportionment.tax_rate_tier2; endif if apportionment.state_taxable_income > vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_2 then set vt_apportionment.calculated_tax = vt_apportionment.calculated_tax + (apportionment.state_taxable_income - vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_2) * vt_apportionment.tax_rate_tier3; endif set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (vt_apportionment.calculated_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "VT tax calculated using graduated brackets: 6% on first $10K, 7% on $10K-$25K, 8.5% over $25K (one of highest state rates). Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5832" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_1 fmin vt_apportionment.tax_rate_tier1 fmul cvd /vt_apportionment.calculated_tax xdef { vt_apportionment.calculated_tax apportionment.state_taxable_income vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_2 fmin vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_1 f- vt_apportionment.tax_rate_tier2 fmul f+ cvd /vt_apportionment.calculated_tax xdef } {} apportionment.state_taxable_income vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_1 f> ifelse { vt_apportionment.calculated_tax apportionment.state_taxable_income vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_2 f- vt_apportionment.tax_rate_tier3 fmul f+ cvd /vt_apportionment.calculated_tax xdef } {} apportionment.state_taxable_income vt_apportionment.bracket_threshold_2 f> ifelse vt_apportionment.calculated_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "VT tax calculated using graduated brackets: 6% on first $10K, 7% on $10K-$25K, 8.5% over $25K (one of highest state rates). Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5832" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No VT nexus - no tax liability; No VT nexus - no tax
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set vt_apportionment.calculated_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No VT nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /vt_apportionment.calculated_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VT nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income; No VT taxable income - no tax
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set vt_apportionment.calculated_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No VT taxable income - no tax. VT NOL rules may apply. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5832" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /vt_apportionment.calculated_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VT taxable income - no tax. VT NOL rules may apply. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5832" job.audit_trail swap addto
